articles.headline: Carys Baker scores 24 and No. 3 Louisville women top Seattle U 97-78 for Great Alaska Shootout title
articles.description: — Carys Baker matched her career-high with 24 points, Zamareya Jones and Amiya Joyner each had a double-double, and No. 3 Louisville beat Seattle U 97-78 on Sunday to claim the program's first Great Alaska Shootout championship.
